blocks.code:
CONFLICT-DIRECTED-BACKJUMPING
  i ← 1;  D'_i ← D_i;  J_i ← ∅
  while 1 ≤ i ≤ n
    instantiate x_i ←
        SELECTVALUE-CBJ
    if x_i is null
      iprev ← i
      i ← index of last
          variable in J_i
      J_i ← J_i ∪ J_iprev
              − {x_i}
    else
      i ← i + 1
      D'_i ← D_i;  J_i ← ∅
  end while
  if i = 0
    return "inconsistent"
  else
    return instantiated
      values of {x_1, …, x_n}

blocks.code:
SELECTVALUE-CBJ
  while D'_i is not empty
    select an arbitrary a ∈ D'_i
      and remove a from D'_i
    consistent ← true
    k ← 1
    while k < i and consistent
      if CONSISTENT(ā_k, x_i = a)
        k ← k + 1
      else
        let R_S be the earliest
        constraint causing the
        conflict; add the
        variables in R_S's
        scope S, but not x_i,
        to J_i
        consistent ← false
    if consistent return a
  return null
